summary: Google announcement that 'skills' (reusable saved instructions invoked with a '/' command) are rolling out globally in Gemini chat. Skills already exist in Gemini Spark and will replace Gems, with Gems support ending from November 2026 for personal accounts and in 2027 for Workspace customers. Written by Google as a vendor product post.
relevance_reason: This is a chat-interface feature for saving and reusing prompts. It touches personal context lightly (writing-style personalization, Drive files) but is not about computer-use agents, devices or voice. It is a passing, incremental mention for the themes.

claims.claim: Google is rolling out skills in Gemini chat globally, with Workspace business, enterprise, nonprofit and education customers following in the coming weeks.
claims.quote: Today, we’re rolling out skills directly into Gemini chat globally 1 , and bringing this functionality to Google Workspace business, enterprise, nonprofit, and education customers in the coming weeks.

claims.claim: A saved skill is invoked by typing a forward slash and its name in the prompt bar.
claims.quote: Once you create a skill, you can easily use it again just by typing a forward slash ‘/’ and the skill’s name directly in the prompt bar.

claims.claim: Gemini can build skills from existing chats and run them automatically on matching prompts; multiple skills can be stacked.
claims.quote: Gemini can help you build custom skills from your chats and automatically run them whenever you enter a matching prompt.

claims.claim: Gemini is said to know the user's writing style across Workspace apps to speed up drafting (a personal-context feature, stated by the vendor without evidence).
claims.quote: Gemini knows your unique writing style across Workspace apps to speed up drafting, all while keeping you in full control.

claims.claim: Skills will replace Gems, with Gems support removed starting November 2026 for personal accounts, and March and June 2027 for Workspace business and education customers; Opal 2 also shuts down in November.
claims.quote: we will remove support for Gems starting in November for individuals with personal accounts, March 2027 for Workspace business, enterprise, and nonprofit customers, and June 2027 for Workspace education customers.

commercial_interest: Vendor (Google) describing its own product; no independent testing or user evidence, and benefit claims are promotional.
older_event: No. The skills rollout is announced as new, dated 2026-09-30. Skills in Gemini Spark already existed; what is new is availability in Gemini chat and the Gems retirement timeline.
